shawn-mgr: Heads-up  I'm prepping an out-of-cycle promo packet for Lina (L3->L4) after she took on GA ownership of our ingestion pipeline. Quick Qs: what's the absolute minimum to avoid auto-reject?

maria-hr: Congrats. Minimum to pass initial screen: manager justification (3-4 bullets, metric-first), evidence field with 2-3 concrete artifacts (PRs/dashboards), 2 anonymized peer calibration notes, proposed band+percentile (not raw $), and funding source.

jamal-comp: Add for OOC: call out why this is accidental/exceptional vs. normal cycle (e.g., scope permanently expanded, retention risk). If comp bump >15% or equity refresh included, you need exec sponsor + Finance sign-off.

shawn-mgr: Is a single customer email praising the work helpful or do we need more?

maria-hr: Helpful if redacted. One short customer quote + dashboard metric is enough; don't attach full threads with PII. Legal will ask for redaction.

rita-fin: Funding: options are hiring reallocation, discretionary comp pool, or spot bonus. Hiring reallocation requires headcount forecast update and GC approval if net-new headcount is affected. If you pick hiring_realloc, include GL codes.

payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoffs: for retro pay to the next payroll, packet must be fully approved and in payroll queue by 1951236000 UTC. Off-cycle runs possible but require payroll lead approval and a 3 business-day window.

people-ops-bot: Form link: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/ooc-promo. Required fields: employee_id, manager, current_level, requested_level, evidence, comp_rationale (band+pct), comp_change_pct, funding_source, exec_sponsor (if >15%), equity_refresh_yes_no, proposed_effective_date, backpay_yes_no.

shawn-mgr: For evidence bullets  any preferred micro-template? Don't want to be vague.

maria-hr: Use: Action (past) + timeframe + measurable outcome + scope. Eg: "Owned ingestion GA (Q1Q2), reduced median pipeline lag by 55% and removed a daily manual run, now impacting 3 products." Keep bullets to one line each.

jamal-comp: Also include an internal parity line: list 2 peers at target level and say how Lina compares on scope/outcomes (no salaries). That helps calibration.

global-comp-bot: Note for international employees: local labor laws may affect effective_date and tax withholdings. If Lina is in EU, include country and local comp note in the packet. People Ops will route to Global Payroll.

rita-fin: If you plan a >10% comp-only bump without level change, Finance will ask for retention evidence (counteroffer, criticality) and funding details.

shawn-mgr: If I request backpay=yes and committee approves, is backpay guaranteed?

people-ops-bot: Backpay policy: committee approval allows request for retro pay up to 90 days. Payroll constraints may still delay processing; approvals after cutoff apply to next run. >90 days needs exec sponsor.

anna-peopleops: Tip: include a 1-paragraph "executive summary" at the top of the packet and a 1-page before/after scope table. Reviewers love a quick read. That materially reduces follow-up questions.

shawn-mgr: Good call. How many anonymized peer notes is typical for borderline cases?

maria-hr: Standard 2. For borderline or cross-functional requests, add a 3rd peer from a partnering team (PM/Infra). Keep each note 1-2 lines.

jamal-comp: Turnaround expectations: clean OOC packet with exec sponsor = 48-72 business hours (ad-hoc committee). Without exec sponsor, expect 7-10 business days. Mark as "urgent" only with clear business reason.

shawn-mgr: If comp committee pushes back, is there an appeal?

maria-hr: Yes  there's an appeals window of 14 days. Manager can submit an appeal_packet with new material; request a 10-15 minute hearing if needed. Appeals can request re-review of effective_date/backpay but payroll rules still apply.

shawn-mgr: Anything that routinely gets packets kicked back?

rita-fin: Common rejects: missing funding source, no parity/context, missing evidence links or broken permissions, or expecting exact $ without band/percentile.

shawn-mgr: Noted. I'll draft the exec summary + before/after table, attach a dashboard screencap and one redacted customer quote, set funding_source=hiring_realloc and loop Finance. Will ping once submitted.

people-ops-bot: submission_received=1951234721 by shawn-mgr. Packet status: pending manager sign-off and Finance funding confirmation.
